translations.web: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
translations.bsb: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and He let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.
translations.kjv: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
